purpose: Motion-study clay sheets; preserve identity and body type, remove loose garment motion

assets.initialPrompt:
Create a professional 3D clay-rendered character reference sheet for Fukuchan, a 48-year-old slender Japanese male motion actor, 170 cm tall. Use the attached reference for his recognizable face, dark short hairstyle silhouette and lean ordinary adult proportions. He is fully clothed in an opaque fitted high-neck long-sleeved motion capture training suit, with full-length pants and fitted training shoes. Render the suit, shoes and head as smooth matte light gray clay. The outfit is simple and practical, without jacket tails, straps, badges, wrinkles or decorative detail; retain clear human elbow, knee, shoulder and hip silhouettes. Not a muscular superhero. Hair is a simple sculpted cap with the reference hairstyle. Hands uncovered in the same clay material, five relaxed fingers.
Landscape turnaround with exactly three aligned full-body orthographic views of the SAME actor: FRONT, RIGHT SIDE with nose toward image right, BACK. Identical relaxed A-pose with arms 20 degrees away from torso, feet hip-width apart, empty hands, head upright and eyes forward. Same height and proportions in all views. Natural human joints, no visible mechanical joints. Warm gray torso/head; a subtle muted peach tint on the LEFT sleeve and pant leg, a subtle muted blue-gray tint on the RIGHT sleeve and pant leg; anatomical side colors consistent across views. Plain off-white background, soft even studio illumination, slight contact shadows, entire body and shoes within each panel.
Small clean typography only: 'FUKUCHAN / MOTION CLAY / 170 cm' above and 'FRONT', 'RIGHT SIDE', 'BACK' below their respective views. No props or extra views. This sheet is for clothed motion-study proportions and animation reference, with a clean practical clay-rendered appearance.
assets.finalEditPrompt:
Refine Image 1, the Fukuchan motion sheet, into the smooth clay motion-maquette treatment illustrated by Image 2. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and sole identity/body reference; Image 2 is MATERIAL STYLE ONLY, never copy its bulky body, mask or face.
Keep Fukuchan's existing recognizable face and hair silhouette, slim 170 cm ordinary adult proportions, view layout and three full-body views. Change the outfit surface into a fitted fully opaque one-piece motion capture suit, entirely rendered in uniform pale warm-gray matte clay like Image 2. Remove all peach/blue colors. Remove the separate jacket hem, cuffs, folds at elbows and ankles, fabric creases, shoe laces, stitching and textile texture. The full-cover suit and simple closed footwear stay present, but their exterior is smooth sculpted clay with no loose fabric. Keep the slender waist, lean chest, narrow shoulders, natural elbows and knees easy to read. Do not broaden him into the stocky body of Image 2. Hands remain five-fingered and empty.
Three aligned orthographic full-body views: FRONT, SIDE, BACK. Same scale and neutral A-pose with arms gently away from torso; do not crop head or feet. Neutral forward head angle. Simplify fine hair strands into broad sculpted hair shapes while retaining his hairstyle and face. Off-white background and soft even diffuse lighting. Natural human silhouette, not a robot or ball-jointed doll.
Text exactly 'FUKUCHAN / MOTION CLAY / 170 cm' and labels 'FRONT', 'SIDE', 'BACK'. No other text or props.

assets.prompt:
Create a clean clay-rendered motion-reference turnaround of SOBAYA, using the attached character sheet for his exact broad silhouette, short dark hairstyle and white red-and-black mask. Height 180 cm, mass 100 kg: broad shoulders, thick chest, substantial abdomen, thick upper arms and thighs. Keep a realistic stocky muscular adult human build, not a thin athlete or exaggerated bodybuilder. Keep his distinctive mask fully and correctly worn in every view. All visible surfaces including hair and mask are matte sculpted clay; maintain mask geometry and markings in restrained low contrast to indicate identity and forward direction.
He wears a fully covering opaque one-piece high-neck motion-capture bodysuit with integrated full-length leggings and simple closed footwear. Render this outfit as a seamless smooth solid clay surface, not fabric: no draping, no folds, no wrinkles, no knit texture, no jacket, no pockets, no loose garment edges, no boot laces. The suit is one uniform pale warm gray. Natural elbows and knees must be easy to see through the fitted outer silhouette, but no robotic ball joints or mechanical seams. Five fingers on each relaxed empty hand. This is a clothed motion-study maquette.
Exactly three aligned full-body orthographic views across one landscape sheet: FRONT, SIDE with face toward image right, BACK. Same actor at exactly the same scale and identical relaxed A-pose, arms 20 degrees away from torso, feet hip-width apart, both soles on the baseline, head upright looking forward. Each view entirely visible with margins. Do not copy the original T-shirt, pants, beer mug or original reference sheet layout. No handheld props for this base motion sheet.
Off-white studio background, even diffuse lighting and soft contact shadows. Clean technical sculpture render, smooth clay surfaces with no surface texture. Small restrained text only: 'SOBAYA / MOTION CLAY / 180 cm / 100 kg' above, and 'FRONT', 'SIDE', 'BACK' below. Preserve a thick torso in side view and keep the same limb lengths and face/mask identity in all views.

review.bodyTypes: slender Fukuchan versus stocky muscular Sobaya
review.props: empty hands for base movement studies
review.surface: uniform matte clay over fitted full-body suit; loose fabric removed
review.identity: Fukuchan face retained, Sobaya mask retained
review.limitations: Reference illustrations, not dimensionally calibrated renders of the game mesh. Side view lowers the arms relative to front/back; use front/back as the A-pose reference.

body_reference_priority: User correction: prioritize original character-sheet silhouette over numerical height/weight interpretations.

revisions.change: Reduce abdomen protrusion, waist/hip and leg bulk while retaining muscular shoulders and arms. Remove numeric title labels.
